channel.desc: Meet former healthcare administrator and now President of Country Life Natural Foods, as he shares insights on health, wellness, and the power of nutritious, plant-based living. With over 60 years of experience in providing high-quality, non-GMO, and organic pantry staples, Country Life Natural Foods is committed to making healthy eating accessible for families and communities alike.
